name: hollerpost-mcp

tools.name: workspace_info
tools.description: Start here. Returns who this key belongs to: workspace name, plan, trial status, emails left, the scopes this key has, and the brand (voice, colors, from name, sending domain). Free and read only; uses no quota. Call it at the start of a conversation so you know which tools this key may use and how to write on-brand. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: brand_get
tools.description: Returns the brand settings: workspace and from name, reply-to, logo, colors, footer address, the saved writing voice and the sending domain status. Free and read only. Read this before writing any campaign copy and follow the voice exactly. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: brand_set_voice
tools.description: Saves the brand voice notes (how this business writes: tone, words to use or avoid). Replaces the previous voice text entirely, so read brand_get first and include anything worth keeping. Uses no quota and sends nothing. Reversible by saving the old text again. Only save what the person dictated or approved. Requires API key scope: draft.

voice.description: The full voice notes to save, in plain sentences. Replaces the current text.

tools.name: templates_list
tools.description: Lists the email templates and, for each, the blocks_schema (JSON Schema for heading, body_md, cta_text, cta_url, image_url, image_alt). Free and read only. Pick a template here before campaign_draft and fill only the blocks its schema accepts. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: segments_list
tools.description: Lists contact tags with the number of subscribed contacts on each. Free and read only. Use it to choose a campaign audience by tag and to tell the person roughly how many people a send reaches. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: contacts_search
tools.description: Finds contacts by exact email, status or tag, newest first. Free and read only. Status "subscribed" means active; "unsubscribed" covers suppressed addresses. Returns at most `limit` rows (default 50, max 200). Requires API key scope: read.

email.description: Exact email address to look up.

status.description: Filter by status. subscribed = active, unsubscribed = suppressed.

tag.description: Only contacts that carry this tag.

limit.description: How many rows to return (1 to 200, default 50).

tools.name: contacts_add
tools.description: Adds one contact, or merges tags into an existing one. Uses no send quota. ONLY add a person who agreed to receive marketing email from this business (for example they signed up, or the person you are helping confirms they opted in). If you are not sure, ask first. Addresses that unsubscribed, bounced or complained cannot be re-added. Not reversible through these tools (there is no delete tool), so check the email is right. Requires API key scope: contacts.

tags.description: Tags to add, for example ["vip"]. Merged with existing tags.

consent.description: Must be true. Confirms this person agreed to receive marketing email from this business. Never set it on a guess.

tools.name: campaign_draft
tools.description: Creates a campaign as a DRAFT. Nothing is sent and no quota is used. Before calling: read brand_get for the voice, pick a template from templates_list, and pick the audience from segments_list. You fill the content blocks; Hollerpost renders the email with the brand header, footer and unsubscribe link. Returns the id, audience_count and a preview_url to share with the person. Next step: campaign_preview, then campaign_send_test. Requires API key scope: draft.

name.description: Internal campaign name (recipients do not see it).

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject in most inboxes.

body_md.description: Body copy in Markdown. Hollerpost renders it inside the brand template.

cta_text.description: Button label, for example "Book a visit".

image_alt.description: Alt text for the hero image. Required whenever image_url is set.

blocks.description: Content blocks for the template. Check templates_list for the blocks_schema of the template you pick. Never send raw HTML: Hollerpost renders the blocks with the brand header, footer, unsubscribe link and address.

tags.description: Send to subscribed contacts with ANY of these tags. Get tags from segments_list.

all.description: Send to every subscribed contact in the workspace.

audience.description: Who gets it: {"tags": ["vip"]} for tagged contacts, or {"all": true} for every subscribed contact.

tools.name: campaign_update
tools.description: Edits a campaign while it is still a draft: any of name, template, subject, preheader, blocks or audience. Fields you leave out stay as they are; blocks you pass replace the whole blocks object. Uses no quota and sends nothing. Refused with campaign_locked once the campaign is scheduled or sent. Run campaign_preview again after editing. Requires API key scope: draft.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

body_md.description: Body copy in Markdown. Hollerpost renders it inside the brand template.

cta_text.description: Button label, for example "Book a visit".

image_alt.description: Alt text for the hero image. Required whenever image_url is set.

blocks.description: Content blocks for the template. Check templates_list for the blocks_schema of the template you pick. Never send raw HTML: Hollerpost renders the blocks with the brand header, footer, unsubscribe link and address.

tags.description: Send to subscribed contacts with ANY of these tags. Get tags from segments_list.

all.description: Send to every subscribed contact in the workspace.

audience.description: Who gets it: {"tags": ["vip"]} for tagged contacts, or {"all": true} for every subscribed contact.

tools.name: campaign_preview
tools.description: Renders a draft and returns the text version, the live audience_count, quota_after_send and warnings (empty subject, missing button, over quota, first campaign pending review). Free, read only, sends nothing. Always call this before campaign_schedule and tell the person the audience count, the quota it will use and every warning. Requires API key scope: draft.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

tools.name: campaign_send_test
tools.description: Sends a test copy of a draft to up to 3 addresses. The addresses must belong to users of this workspace; other addresses are refused. Uses quota only for the test emails actually sent, does not touch the audience, and does not change the draft. Offer this after campaign_preview so the person can check it in their own inbox. Requires API key scope: draft.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

to.description: 1 to 3 addresses of people who use this workspace.

tools.name: campaign_schedule
tools.description: Schedules a drafted campaign to send to its audience. This is not reversible once sending starts, and it uses one email of quota per recipient. Call campaign_preview first, tell the person the audience count and the quota it uses, and only call this after they say yes. Pass the audience count you showed them as expected_audience_count; if the list changed meaningfully the call is refused. A workspace's first campaign is held for a one-time human review instead of sending (review_pending); say so plainly and do not retry. Before send_at, campaign_cancel can still stop it. Requires API key scope: send.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

send_at.description: "now", or an ISO 8601 time with timezone such as 2026-10-05T09:00:00-07:00.

expected_audience_count.description: The audience count you showed the person from campaign_preview.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the person explicitly approved this send and its audience count.

tools.name: campaign_cancel
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled campaign before it starts sending. Only works while the status is scheduled; once sending has started it cannot be stopped. Uses no quota. Confirm with the person which campaign they mean (campaigns_list with status scheduled) before calling. Requires API key scope: send.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

tools.name: campaigns_list
tools.description: Lists campaigns, newest first, optionally filtered by status (draft, scheduled, sending, sent, held_for_review, canceled). Free and read only. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: campaign_stats
tools.description: Returns delivery and engagement numbers for a campaign: sent, delivered, bounced, complained, opened, clicked, unsubscribed and top links. Free and read only. Requires API key scope: read.

id.description: Campaign id, as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Sends ONE transactional email (a receipt, a reply, a booking confirmation) to one address right away. Not reversible, and it uses one email of quota. Never use it for marketing or to mail a list: campaigns are for that. Show the person the recipient, subject and body and get a yes before calling. idempotency_key is required: reuse the same key if you retry so the email is not sent twice. Pass html, text, or both. Requires API key scope: send.

html.description: HTML body. Hollerpost adds the brand header.

reply_to.description: Reply-to address, if different from the workspace default.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this email, for example "receipt-1042". Reusing it returns the first result instead of sending again.

tools.name: events_recent
tools.description: Lists recent delivery events of one type across campaigns and transactional mail: email.bounced (default), email.complained or email.delivered. Free and read only. Useful for list hygiene and deliverability questions. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: account_get
tools.description: Returns the plan, billing period end, email and SMS quota used and limit, trial status and the send packs available. Free and read only. Check it before a large send. Plan changes and purchases are never done through tools: use billing_portal_link to give the person a link. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: account_update
tools.description: Updates the workspace name, from name, reply-to address or the physical footer address (required by law in marketing email). Uses no quota. Reversible by setting the old value again. Billing can never be changed here. Confirm the new values with the person first. Requires API key scope: account.

from_name.description: Name recipients see in the From field.

footer_address.description: Physical mailing address printed in every campaign footer.

tools.name: domain_add
tools.description: Adds a sending domain (one per workspace) and returns the exact DNS records to create, plus registrar_hint (cloudflare, godaddy, namecheap, route53, vercel or unknown). Uses no quota. Safe to call again: an existing domain returns its current records. If you have a DNS provider tool for that registrar connected, offer to add the records yourself; otherwise show them as a table and point the person to their DNS settings or the Hollerpost dashboard. Then call domain_verify. Requires API key scope: account.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

tools.name: domain_list
tools.description: Lists the sending domain and its status (pending, verified or failed) with each DNS record and whether it was found. Free and read only. Check this before drafting: a workspace that must send from its own domain cannot schedule until it is verified. Requires API key scope: read.

tools.name: domain_verify
tools.description: Re-checks the DNS records for a sending domain now and returns, per record, whether it was found plus expected vs actual values. Uses no quota, changes nothing, safe to repeat. DNS changes can take minutes to a few hours to show up; if records are missing right after adding them, wait a bit and try again. Explain any wrong record in plain words. Requires API key scope: account.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

tools.name: domain_remove
tools.description: Removes the sending domain from this workspace. Destructive: campaigns cannot be scheduled from it afterwards, and adding it back gives new DNS records to set up again. Refused with domain_in_use while a campaign is scheduled on it. Uses no quota. Only call when the person explicitly asked to remove this exact domain. Requires API key scope: account.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the person explicitly asked to remove this domain.

tools.name: billing_portal_link
tools.description: Returns a short-lived link to the Stripe billing portal for the person to open in their browser, where they can change plan, update a card or buy send packs. This is the only billing tool: you never change plans or buy anything yourself. Free; changes nothing. The link expires, so get a fresh one when needed and do not store it. Requires API key scope: account.

instructions: Hollerpost sends email campaigns for a small business. You draft, preview, test and report; the person approves every send. Start with workspace_info to learn the plan, the key scopes and the brand voice. Campaigns are created as drafts. Before campaign_schedule always run campaign_preview, tell the person the audience count and quota use, and wait for a yes. A workspace first campaign is held for a one-time human review (review_pending): it is not sent yet, do not retry. Only add contacts who agreed to receive email. No tool can change billing; billing_portal_link gives the person a link.
